name: Kissing!! ~under the mistletoe~
source:
Christmas might be doomed! As chance would have it, only an unassuming Japanese student can save the winter holiday - but in order to do so he must first discover true love and receive it in turn. Yet such a task might prove impossible, for how can Koutaro find romance, when he’s always been oblivious to it?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080827195700/http://www.erogereview.com/2007/12/25/kissing-under-the-mistletoe/trackback/]Nargrakhan review[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节可能要完蛋了！机缘巧合之下，只有一名不起眼的日本学生能够拯救这个冬日节庆——但要做到这一点，他必须先发现真爱，并让对方也爱上自己。然而，这项任务或许根本不可能完成：幸太郎一直对爱情迟钝得要命，又该如何找到恋情？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080827195700/http://www.erogereview.com/2007/12/25/kissing-under-the-mistletoe/trackback/]Nargrakhan的评测[/url]]
